source: Dubai Data Manual v5.0, DDM-008 Data Quality (nine dimensions, p.5; standards DDM-008.1 to DDM-008.7; Relevance and Availability mandatory requirements pp.16 to 17); Reconciliation is a KHDA addition (DP-06 5.1)
confirm: with DDSE: DDM-008 lists nine dimensions; its glossary and annex list six

dimensions.measure: Share of values that match the authoritative source or pass accuracy rules
Share of values consistent across systems and views
Share of records captured within the committed lag (timeliness matrix)
Share of records without duplicates on the key
Share of values that pass format, range and code-list rules
Share of critical data elements with a definition, unit and business rule in the data dictionary

dimensions.ddm: DDM-008 dimension 7 (mandatory requirement, no numbered standard)
dimensions.measure: Share of collected fields linked to a stated purpose, KPI or mandate

dimensions.ddm: DDM-008 dimension 9 (mandatory requirement, no numbered standard)
dimensions.measure: Share of scheduled refreshes of certified views delivered on time
Share of totals that reconcile between source and published figures

note: Seed data holds values for the six dimensions measured today and Reconciliation; Interpretability, Relevance and Availability have no baseline until their method and threshold are decided (BR-127).
